title: Geraldine O NDE 338/20531 NDE 20531
content:
338 I fell asleep sitting in my chair at my desk. I awoke later to see my granddaughter there in front of me playing with the cat. That is the last conscious memory that I had until I woke up in ICU. There are other things though that are in my mind. Blackness, soft and not frightening. I knew exactly where I lay on the ground. I could see myself but not with my eyes. It was more like with my mind. I asked a question, 'What happened to me? Did I have a stroke?' That is the last very clear memory that I had of the experience but there was more. I was not alone. All I can remember now is a color against the blackness. Not the type of color one would expect. It was a weathered cream color. Sort of like the color that one would expect the tattered robes of Jesus might be. I can't say that I saw Jesus or any specific individual. I remember a presence and a color and although I am not sure about this there seems to be a vague presence of doors. I remember communication but I don't remember what was said. The only thing that I can remember is a very deep feeling that the number 3 was very important. It was what I was supposed to remember. Always remember the number 3. That is it. I know that I experience communication with someone and I want so much to remember it all but all I come back with is the number three. I have a daughter and two grandchildren that my life revolves around and very possibly the number represents them and how important they are, I just can't remember enough to be sure.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Illness Clinical death I had a cardiac arrest due to chemical imbalances in my body. | Yes Illness Clinical death I stopped breathing and had turned blue with no pulse when my daughter found me and began trying to resuscitate me.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Void | Darkness | Strong emotional tone | Presence of unearthly beings | Light | Special Knowledge
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I was on the floor. I was looking down at myself from about two feet above, but I was not seeing with my eyes. Later I learned that I did fall exactly in the place and position that I seemed to be aware of. | Yes It was me. The same me. I actually saw my hands when I raised them in shock.
elements.At what time during the experience were: None. I have no memory of the actual attack or two days after | The same as it is right now.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning | Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Only that I came back with the knowledge that time is not real.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Uncertain I was in a very dark place but it did not seem to be a tunnel and I did not leave that place. | No
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes See above | Yes Just the one person who spoke to me.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: No | Yes I saw the light as I was being taken away from it.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm Yes the black place was very distinctive, not like the blackness of night but more like black velvet. | No
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: At first confusion. Then the feeling that I was learning something very important. | I was shocked at first discovering the separation. There was no fear at any time.
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe As I said I can't seem to bring it to consciousness but I am very aware that something was communicated to me. | Everything about the universe I now know that time is not real.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control YES but I can't consciously remember what I learned. I know I was given knowledge but it is making me crazy trying to remember it consciously.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will | No
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: No | Uncertain Material things have never been very important, but there are even less now. I’m not sure if this is from the near death experience or just a part of getting older.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes My conscious memory of the experience is vague. I am very aware that much more happened than I can remember. It is like waking up in the morning and remembering that you had a dream but you can't quite remember the dream itself. | No
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: I died. I died. | The best was the confirmation of an afterlife. The worst was dealing with eight year old granddaughter’s trauma at seeing me die.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes My daughter. She is interested | Yes Some were interested and others not at all.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: No | Yes I have awakened during the night to find myself floating over my bed. This has happened two times.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: Only that I am curious to know if others have had this same type of experience.
elements.Did your hearing differ in any way from: The voice of the person seeing me off.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes I have many psychic experiences. More now than ever.
